scope: fan-support-gateway-v1 CARD/LOCAL_PAYMENT transport and Standard Webhooks v1 verification; no vendor payment integration
boundaries: Only deployed normalized-gateway adapterVersion 1.0.0 protocol fan-support-gateway-v1 is accepted.
Any connection containing STABLECOIN is rejected before network; webhook requires identical supported connection binding.
GET_PAYMENT has no requestedLocale field; adapter checks allowed locale mapping pairs, Application retains responsibility for comparing the frozen attempt locale.
Webhook produces an authenticated candidate only; inbox deduplication, association and settlement remain in the existing persistence path.
Webhook maxBodyBytes is additionally bounded by the existing 65536-character rawBodyBase64 contract.
Real TLS tests use an owned CA with rejectUnauthorized=true and verified configured SAN; no system trust changes.
No actual vendor account, sandbox or payment was contacted. Root owns full repository checks.

CREATE carries the account-selected instrument; GET_CAPABILITIES carries configured instruments. The remote gateway must implement and enforce this protocol; wire declaration is not actual Visa/Mastercard/3DS or acquiring certification.
